findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_appeal_route_and_deadline, check_cpr_21_10_approval, calculate_financial_remedy_timetable, check_small_claims_costs · Private data: get_statement_of_truth_wording, calculate_cpr_deadline, check_relief_from_sanctions, find_detailed_assessment_court, check_cpr_21_10_approval, calculate_financial_remedy_timetable · Public sink: calculate_cpr_deadline, calculate_pre_action_protocol_deadlines.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_appeal_route_and_deadline, check_cpr_21_10_approval, calculate_financial_remedy_timetable, check_small_claims_costs · Private data: get_statement_of_truth_wording, calculate_cpr_deadline, check_relief_from_sanctions, find_detailed_assessment_court, check_cpr_21_10_approval, calculate_financial_remedy_timetable · Public sink: calculate_cpr_deadline, calculate_pre_action_protocol_deadlines

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
